sources.description: One prospect the Denver Broncos could select in the second round of the 2026 NFL Draft is Iowa offensive lineman Gennings Dunker. He is a 6-5, 319-pound offensive lineman who played tackle in college but is projected to shift inside to guard in the NFL. The Athletic’s lead draft analyst, Dane Brugler, has Dunker ranked […]
